name: MIAPI
description: Grounded-answer API that returns citations, with a monthly free query allowance.
overview: MIAPI answers questions with web grounding and inline citations through a single `miapi-grounded` model. The Free plan covers every endpoint with 100 queries per month per account and 60 requests/minute; questions are capped at 2,000 characters and answers at 50–2,000 output tokens. Usage logs are retained for up to 90 days, and no card is required.

privacy.label: Usage logs kept up to 90 days

notes: Grounded search answers only — not a general chat endpoint.
